easyPrerequisites: You control three creatures with different powers, including Heart of Kiran if Aminatou has two or more loyalty counters on it.
description:
If Aminatou has two or more loyalty counters on it, activate Heart of Kiran by removing a loyalty counter from Aminatou, causing Heart of Kiran to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Repeat step 1 until Aminatou has one loyalty counter on it.
Activate Aminatou's second loyalty ability by removing a loyalty counter from it, targeting Redemption Choir.
Aminatou is put into your graveyard as a state-based action due to having zero loyalty.
Resolve the Aminatou ability, blinking Redemption Choir.
When Redemption Choir enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Aminatou from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.
